query:
SELECT work_id, url FROM work_link
         WHERE work_id IN
            (SELECT id FROM work
             WHERE library_id = ?1
               AND (?2 IS NULL OR id = ?2)
               AND (?3 IS NULL OR id IN (SELECT work_id FROM publication_work WHERE publication_id = ?3))
               AND (?4 IS NULL OR id IN (SELECT work_id FROM tag WHERE tag = ?4)))
         ORDER BY id
